## Cartwheels Programs

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/Term_dates_20262027.png)

[Program Registration](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php) [Schedule at a glance](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/forms/Term_1_Schedule_2026-27.pdf)

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/programs_top2.jpg)

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/programs_tiny.jpg)

[Tiny Gym (1 and walking to 3 years) 45 minutes Your child's first gym class! This class is for our youngest gymnasts with their parent/caregiver. It focuses on both sensory and gross motor development, co-ordination, balance, strength, flexibility, social skills, and fun!! **The 1-year old participants are strongly recommended to be fully independently walking before the term begins. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/programs_babyrocker.jpg)

[Rock n' Roll with Miss Kelly (0+ years) 45 minutes This class offers a safe environment for your child to grow physically, cognitively, and socially through music and movement. In this class we will use sensory rich props and musical instruments as we enjoy interactive playtime through song, dance, and physical literacy. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term. Music Instructor - Platinum Music Instruction - Gold](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/programs_tumble_learn.jpg)

[Tumble & Learn (2y 11m to 4 years) 2 hours Preschool & Kindergarten readiness program at Cartwheels. Tumble n’ Learn will focus on gross and fine motor development; sensory skills; strength, coordination, balance, and flexibility; independence and social skills. This two-hour drop-off program will include 45-minutes of a structured gymnastics class, music class, learning activity, group games, and a healthy snack break (nut/peanut free snack brought weekly by participants). This program allows participants to register for longer than one term length for increased development and continuity for the children Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/programs_mini.jpg)

[Mini Gym (3/3½ - 4 years) 45 minutes Our eligibility rule for Mini Gym is that they have just participated in our Tiny Gym program (in the term prior to their move to Mini Gym) AND are showing signs of readiness to participate without a parent, OR are already 3 ½ when registering. If your child is new to Cartwheels, OR is a returning member with a break between participating in our terms, and they are not yet three years + six months prior to the term start date, they must register into Tiny Gym. This is to learn the routine, expectations, and structure of our program. No exceptions due to the demand & limited Mini Gym spots. **Participants must also be fully toilet trained (no pull-ups) to register into Mini Gym. If you choose to proceed with registration past the pop-up informing you of these requirements, you will be contacted to move to Tiny Gym or refund/credit your registration until they are eligible. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/programs_kinder.jpg)

[Kindergym (4-6 years) 55 minutes A fast paced class geared to channel this age group's energy in a positive direction. This class provides opportunities to build social skills, self-confidence, and develop physical and motor attributes including: flexibility, strength, power, and endurance as well as balance and spatial orientation. All this in a gymnastics setting! Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. Pricing information is not available on the main site due to the terms varying in length over the season, resulting in pricing fluctuations term by term.](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/registration.php)

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/programs_junior.jpg)

[JR Gym (6-8 years) 55 minutes This recreational program is for those wanting to experience the fun and thrill of gymnastics! The program promotes physical fitness and allows children to achieve new skills by focusing on their strengths and encouraging development of their weaker areas. They work on an achievement program consisting of a system of progressive skills that each child works on at their own pace. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. They work on an achievement program consisting of a system of progressive skills that each child works on at their own pace. This class will focus on strength and flexibility training as well as more advanced skills. Participants must be invited from Cartwheels programming and registration requires a code to unlock the program. Availability and pricing available by logging into our Registration Website. ## Registration

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/Term_dates_20262027.png) [Our Programs](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/programs.php)  

[Register On-Line](https://cartwheelsgymcentre.uplifterinc.com/login/)

## Registration Discount Offers

- **3rd Sibling Discount** - three children from the same family, within the same term, on the same invoice.
- **Multi-Class Discount** - 1 child, registering for 2 classes within the same term, on the same invoice.*

More info:

This discount offer will only apply to "term" programming September through June. The discount offer will not include "camp" or other events.

Both discounts will offer/occur on the lower valued program on an invoice.

*Discount does not apply on Ability Athletics programs.

![](https://www.cartwheelsgymcentre.com/images/registration.jpg)

Payment Policy

Method of Payment

Cartwheels online registration accepts Visa, Mastercard, and (most) debit cards. Gift cards can be purchased by emailing the gym and payment is accepted by credit card or e-transfer only.

Gymnastics Ontario Fee

“The Gymnastics Ontario Fee for $45.00 that you will see listed on your invoice includes an annual membership with Gymnastics Ontario. Cartwheels Gym Centre (along with other gymnastics clubs in Ontario) are governed by Gymnastics Ontario. All of our coaches, athletes, judges and supporters (recreational and competitive) are required to be registered with Gymnastics Ontario in order to be covered by their insurance policy.

Gymnastics Ontario begins their annual coverage July 1, each season and it expires the following June 30. Anyone who is registered in a program at Cartwheels Gym Centre must be registered with them. This is an annual fee, so if you join a program at any time between July 1, and June 30, each child will be charged the Gymnastics Ontario Fee of $45.00. This membership fee is transferable between Gymnastics Ontario member clubs, so if you join Cartwheels Gym Centre throughout the membership year and you were attending another member club, you will not be required to pay this fee again. Please notify us at time of registration so we may transfer your insurance.”

Inclement Weather Policy

Class Cancellations

Weekday morning classes are cancelled if the Halton District School Board announces school buses are cancelled in our area/zone. There will be a social media post and a change to our voicemail message by 8:00am should daytime programming be cancelled. We do
 not send emails for inclement weather notifications.  

Should weather effect evening class times (Monday-Thursday), or weekend class times (Saturday & Sundays) there will be a social media post and voicemail by 3:00pm or 8:00am. Should there be a need to cancel after the evening classes have begun for any reason,
 we will immediately post to social media, do our best to call later evening participants, and a sign will be posted on our entrance door. We do not send emails for inclement weather notifications.  

If severe inclement weather was to threaten a party booking requiring it to be cancelled by Cartwheels for the safety of our guests and staff, we would return the deposit paid upon booking.  

Please call or check our Facebook/Instagram or “News from the gym” box on our website should the weather be questionable. No make-up classes are given if cancelled due to inclement weather due to term scheduling, class ratios, and weather being out of our control.  

We take inclement weather cancellations very seriously for the safety of our participating families and staff.

Refund Policy

Refunds/Credits

Due to coach/athlete ratios and scheduling, make up classes or credits for missed classes are not offered/available should you miss a class due to vacation, illness, or other.

Should our programming not be a perfect fit for your child, Cartwheels offers a refund of classes not yet taken to new members if requested within the first two weeks of a term. The Gymnastics Ontario membership fee is non-refundable. Returning members are
 not eligible for a credit/refund once a term begins (the posted Term start date for all programs).

Cartwheels will continue to offer a refund of classes not yet taken to new members, if requested within the first two weeks of a term. The Gymnastics Ontario membership fee is non-refundable. Returning members are not eligible for a credit/refund once a term begins.

Illness and Sick Policy

If you or your child is ill, please keep them out of the facility. Same goes for siblings in our viewing area. If a participant shows signs of sickness during their class, they will be removed from the program immediately. A parent will be notified for pick-up
 if not present in the gym.
